metadata.question: Did the Jianghan District of Wuhan show lower nightime light intensity on February 4, 2020, compared to January 19, 2020?

data.raw_code: The question is about comparing nighttime light intensity in Jianghan District, Wuhan between two specific dates: - February 4, 2020 (during COVID-19 lockdown period) - January 19, 2020 (before lockdown) For nighttime lights, I should use VIIRS Day/Night Band (DNB) data from the Suomi NPP or NOAA-20 satellites. The best collection is 'NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG' which provides monthly composites with cloud masking. However, the question asks for specific dates (Feb 4 and Jan 19), but VIIRS data is typically available as monthly composites. I'll need to: 1. Get the monthly composite for January 2020 and February 2020 2. Extract the Jianghan District geometry 3. Compare the average radiance values Let me structure this: - Data: VIIRS DNB monthly composites - Dates: January 2020 vs February 2020 - Location: Jianghan District, Wuhan - Band: 'avg_rad' (average radiance) - Need to check if collections exist and have valid pixels - Compare the values to determine if Feb 4 (represented by Feb composite) is lower than Jan 19 (represented by Jan composite) Since these are specific dates but we only have monthly composites, I'll use the monthly composites as the best available approximation. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Jianghan District, Wuhan approximate bounds var jianghan = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [114.25, 30.57], [114.30, 30.57], [114.30, 30.62], [114.25, 30.62], [114.25, 30.57] ]); // 2. Data Acquisition - VIIRS DNB Monthly Composites var jan2020 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG') .filterDate('2020-01-01', '2020-01-31') .filterBounds(jianghan); var feb2020 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG') .filterDate('2020-02-01', '2020-02-29') .filterBounds(jianghan); // Check if collections exist var janSize = jan2020.size().getInfo(); var febSize = feb2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Jan 2020 Images: ${janSize}, Feb 2020 Images: ${febSize}`); if (janSize === 0 || febSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get first image from each collection var janImg = jan2020.first(); var febImg = feb2020.first(); // 3. Processing - Get pixel counts and mean radiance var janStats = janImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: jianghan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); var febStats = febImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: jianghan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); var janMean = janStats.get('avg_rad').getInfo(); var janCount = janStats.get('avg_rad_count').getInfo(); var febMean = febStats.get('avg_rad').getInfo(); var febCount = febStats.get('avg_rad_count').getInfo(); console.log(`Jan 2020: Mean=${janMean?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels=${janCount}`); console.log(`Feb 2020: Mean=${febMean?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels=${febCount}`); // Check for valid pixels if (janCount === 0 || febCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (janMean === null || febMean === null || isNaN(janMean) || isNaN(febMean) || janMean < 0 || febMean < 0) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare nighttime light intensity if (febMean < janMean) { console.log(`Nighttime lights decreased: ${janMean.toFixed(4)} -> ${febMean.toFixed(4)}`); console.log("A"); } else { console.log(`Nighttime lights same/increased: ${janMean.toFixed(4)} -> ${febMean.toFixed(4)}`); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
